query: Arm Q4 fiscal 2025 data-center royalty revenue Neoverse CPU fiscal Q4 2025 ended March 2025
normalized: 2025 arm center cpu data ended fiscal march neoverse q4 revenue royalty

output.content:
Arm did **not** disclose a standalone Q4 FYE2025 dollar figure for data-center royalty revenue or for Neoverse CPU royalties; it reported only consolidated royalty revenue and described data-center usage as one of its growth drivers. [[1]] 

For the quarter ended **March 31, 2025**, total royalty revenue was **$607 million**, up **18% year over year** from **$514 million**; Arm attributed the increase principally to Armv9 adoption, the ramp of Arm Compute Subsystems (CSS), and greater usage of Arm-based chips in data centers. [[1]] 

Arm also said royalty growth came from all target end markets—including data center, automotive, smartphones, and IoT—but did not quantify any end-market component or identify a Neoverse-specific royalty amount. [[1]] 

Accordingly, **$607 million is the relevant reported Q4 royalty-revenue figure, not data-center/Neoverse revenue**; a data-center royalty number for that quarter cannot be calculated from Arm’s disclosed Q4 FYE2025 financials. [[1]] [[2]]
